definition: God denotes a personal religious ultimate whose personal perfection is the target of this argument. Sig.God w says such a being exists at w; it does not define God as nonexistent whenever a particular human lacks belief. God-to-perfect-love is a separate open premise. This is not the broader possibility of a nonpersonal religious ultimate, nor an automatic identification of the root signature with this interpretation.
